text:
sam-cs: FYI a customer (FinPay) escalated — after today's model rollout their ingest validator is failing with a root-level unexpected key. They say nothing else changed on their side. :warning:

mike-eng: Thanks — which model & what rollout window?

sam-cs: Model flip at 10:12 UTC, from serve://rwd-infer-v1.9 -> serve://rwd-infer-v2.0, canary moved 25%->100% at 10:30. First customer error at 10:35.

nina-pm: Do they have a reproducible example we can paste into our schema validator?

sam-cs: Yes — customer shared request + the failing response. Repro steps they ran: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"order_id":"1234"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'`. Their parser (ajv) throws an exception.

sam-cs: Their expected body (schema) root keys: `order_id`, `items`, `total_amount`. Actual response sample from our API they've pasted: 
```
{
  "meta": {"request_id":"req_Abc123","server_ts":"2026-03-17T10:34:59Z"},
  "order_id": "1234",
  "items": [{"sku":"X1","qty":2}],
  "total_amount": 49.99
}
```

sam-cs: Their validator is strict and fails when it sees `meta` at the root (keywordError: additionalProperties: meta). They say this started immediately post-rollout.

ace-engineer: Odd — our APIs don't usually add a root `meta` wrapper. Did we enable any new response-enrichment feature or header that would wrap payloads?

mike-eng: Check runtime change log — the v2.0 runtime added optional `response_meta` for telemetry on canary, gated behind `response_meta: true` config. That should be off by default. Possible config drift on that host group?

sam-cs: Customer provided `response_headers` and we don't set that. They only changed model.

ace-engineer: Can someone fetch the raw response from our edge logs for that request_id `req_Abc123`? Need to know if wrapper was inserted at the runtime or by a proxy.

mike-eng: Pulling logs... (looking) — I see the model handler emitted the payload without `meta`, but the gateway plugin `resp-enrich` injected the `meta` wrapper for routes with `enable_resp_meta=true`.

sam-cs: So gateway plugin flipped on during the rollout?

mike-eng: It appears a config flag in the canary deployment profile had `enable_resp_meta` accidentally set to true. Canary profile was promoted at 10:30. That explains timing.

nina-pm: Customer impact: strict JSON schema validators will reject these responses. Severity: P1 for FinPay (payments flow). Recommend immediate rollback or toggle off the plugin.

ace-engineer: I can push a hotfix: set `enable_resp_meta=false` for the affected route and roll until stable. Who can approve a config change?

mike-eng: I will — patching the gateway config now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by mike-eng — change: gateway/resp-enrich disable on route /v1/generate (patch id: deploy_7721)

ace-engineer: After patch I'll tail logs for `req_` entries and confirm raw payloads.

sam-cs: Customer asked for an ETA and whether we'll roll back the model. They prefer not to be rolled back if we can fix fast. ETA request: 20–30 mins?

mike-eng: Patch applied at 10:48 UTC. Waiting for propagation across edge cluster.

ace-engineer: Confirming — new logs show responses no longer include `meta` for the route. Sample after fix: 
```
{
  "order_id": "1234",
  "items": [{"sku":"X1","qty":2}],
  "total_amount": 49.99
}
```

sam-cs: Relaying to FinPay now. They will run their tests and report back. :thumbsup:

nina-pm: Action items recorded: 1) revert canary profile to ensure `enable_resp_meta=false` is default for production profiles, 2) add integration test that validates no unknown root keys appear for strict-schema customers, 3) postmortem to explain how config drift occurred during rollout.

mike-eng: Also adding a runtime guard: if route declares `schema_strict=true` then gateway must not inject `meta` at root — we can implement as a config validation in gateway.

sam-cs: FinPay ran their suite — all green. They asked we add a note to the release that a nonfunctional `response_meta` flag existed in canary.

ace-engineer: Closing the immediate remediation. Assigning follow-ups to eng-runtime and eng-ml for the guard and test.

mike-eng: Will open RFC for safer rollout automation for boolean flags.

sam-cs: Thanks team. Marking as resolved unless FinPay reopens. :raised_hands:
